name: Level Order Traversal (BFS)
description: Visits all nodes level by level using a queue (BFS on tree). Produces nodes in breadth-first order.
aim: Traverse a binary tree level by level from root to leaves, visiting all nodes at depth d before any node at depth d+1.
howItWorks: While queue not empty: dequeue front node, visit it
Repeat — all nodes at depth k processed before depth k+1

time.averageCase: Each node enqueued and dequeued once

complexity.spaceDescription: w = max width of tree; O(n) for complete binary tree

realWorld: File system directory listing by depth
Social network: find people within k connections
